updates.title: Multiple Denial of Service Vulnerabilities in Azure AD and ADFS
updates.summary: Microsoft released updates addressing seven denial-of-service vulnerabilities affecting Azure Active Directory and Active Directory Federation Services (CVE-2026-50652, CVE-2026-50653, CVE-2026-50304, CVE-2026-50368, CVE-2026-50324, CVE-2026-50355, CVE-2026-50411, CVE-2026-50647). Admins should apply these patches promptly to prevent potential service disruptions in their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: New SOC Identity Responder Built-in Role
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra introduced a new built-in role—SOC Identity Responder—enabling security teams to perform identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender without requiring multiple high-privilege roles or dependence on identity administrators. This least-privilege role improves incident response speed and reduces operational friction during security events.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now allows admins to target, monitor, and secure AI agent accounts with precision using Custom Security Attributes and agent-specific risk signals. This expands identity governance capabilities to cover the growing AI workload landscape with controls comparable to human user accounts.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Generally Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery is now generally available, automatically backing up critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access policies, and authentication settings. This built-in disaster recovery feature helps admins restore tenants from accidental or malicious changes without external tooling.

updates.title: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users not yet in the directory to access packages using their email address, with automatic guest invitation and governance. This streamlines B2B access provisioning workflows and reduces manual overhead.

updates.title: Domainless SAML Identity Provider Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra now supports domainless SAML federation, allowing external users to authenticate using IdP-managed credentials without requiring email domain matching. This reduces setup complexity and broadens federation flexibility for hybrid workforce scenarios.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs for Microsoft Entra ID in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs are now generally available in the US Gov cloud, providing government customers with standards-based identity lifecycle management for users and groups. This enables organizations to integrate Entra with third-party systems using the widely-adopted SCIM specification.

updates.title: BYOD Support for Windows Client Using Entra Registration
updates.summary: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) support for Windows using Entra registration is now generally available, allowing users and partners to access corporate resources from personal devices with the Private Application traffic profile. This expands flexible workforce access while maintaining network security controls.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Microsoft Authenticator App
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now blocks users with rooted or jailbroken devices from adding or using work or school accounts, enforcing device compliance by default. This strengthens credential protection by preventing Authenticator from operating on compromised mobile platforms.

updates.title: Improved Kerberos Key Rotation Reliability for Incoming Trust Referral Flows
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Kerberos key rotation now validates both primary and secondary keys during authentication, eliminating failures that previously occurred during key rotation in trust referral environments. This improves reliability for hybrid scenarios using cross-forest authentication.

updates.title: Prevent Unauthorized Changes to AD Groups with AD Group Enforcement
updates.summary: Entra Cloud Sync now supports AD group enforcement, allowing admins to designate specific Active Directory groups that can only be modified through Entra provisioning. This prevents accidental or malicious drift and maintains consistency between cloud and on-premises group management.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integration with Entra GSA for Network-Layer File Filtering
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP policies can now intercept and filter sensitive files at the network layer through integration with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access. This enables enforcement of file restrictions across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms before data reaches untrusted cloud services.

updates.title: DLP Restriction for External Emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is expanding to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from external senders, reducing prompt injection and data leakage risks. This real-time control gives admins granular oversight of AI grounding data sources.

updates.title: DLP Safeguards for Sensitive Data in Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP policies are expanding to block sensitive data from being used in external web searches within Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. This prevents unintended exposure of classified information through search engine APIs and external AI platforms.

updates.title: DLP Copilot Processing Restriction for Sensitivity Labels Across All Storage Locations
updates.summary: The DLP policy to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing sensitivity-labeled content in Office apps now applies uniformly regardless of file storage location. This closes gaps in AI governance for hybrid storage scenarios.

updates.title: DLP Event Data Enrichment in Microsoft Defender Graph API
updates.summary: The Microsoft Defender Graph API is being enriched with DLP rule match event details, enabling customers to easily export and correlate DLP alerts with SIEM tools, create automated workflows, and generate custom reports. This simplifies security integration and improves incident correlation.

updates.title: AI-Powered Data Loss Prevention Policy Optimizer
updates.summary: DLP Policy Optimizer uses AI to analyze organizational DLP policies and activity patterns to identify overlapping rules, misconfigurations, and sources of alert noise with prioritized remediation recommendations. This helps admins reduce false positives and improve policy efficacy at scale.

updates.title: Trigger Power Automate Workflows from DLP Rule Matches
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure DLP rules to automatically trigger custom Power Automate workflows when violations are detected, enabling automated remediation, notification, and orchestration at scale. This extends DLP beyond blocking to drive dynamic security operations.

updates.title: Information Protection Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, accelerating sensitivity label application across at-rest data. This faster labeling enables organizations to prepare their data estates for Copilot with greater coverage and confidence.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Data Security Triage Agent Enhancements
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in Insider Risk Management is receiving improvements to user risk and activity explorer pattern summaries, enhancing investigation accuracy and decision quality. These enhancements improve analysts' ability to detect and assess insider threats efficiently.
